daily.reference: same building, timestamps strictly before midnight of evaluated day
daily.past_scoring: rescore past observed loads with current frozen monthly model; past window is after training end, no evaluation-day labels

six.cqr_limit: six-building artifact has no quantile models; do not describe it as CQR

cold.selection: reuse previously fixed 12-building cohort; not chosen using this run
cold.source_model: 11 other buildings per held-out target, frozen residual LightGBM
cold.activation: only when later calibration slice MAE strictly improves versus frozen-source point; no refit on that slice
cold.fallback: frozen-source point when insufficient data or no calibration improvement
cold.interval: calibration-slice absolute residual finite quantile; exploratory coverage only
cold.zero_history_limit: first 168 observed target hours are lag warm-up; no predictions invented before then

metrics: weekly cold-start activation and calibration validation
decision: offline evidence only; no automatic deployment, no champion/export changes
limitations: historical periods previously inspected; not blind validation
no distribution-free conditional guarantee after risk selection
sudden shifts require human review; recent calibration reacts only after outcomes
building-local calibration can reject more hours in formerly low-risk buildings
one-hour forecast uses preceding observed target loads; not open-loop 24-hour prediction
naive source wall clock relabeled UTC; not deployment timezone proof
